listings.name: 1704 N Damen Ave
listings.description: Modern mixed-use retail opportunity located in the heart of Bucktown / Wicker Park, one of Chicago’s most active retail corridors. The property offers 5,139 SF across three levels within a 2018 construction building featuring high-end finishes and a flexible layout suitable for retail, office, or mixed-use tenancy. Positioned along Damen Avenue at the center of a highly trafficked shopping and dining district, the property benefits from strong surrounding tenancy, proximity to the Damen Blue Line station, and immediate access to The 606 Trail. This location provides connectivity to key Chicago neighborhoods including Lincoln Park, West Loop, Fulton Market, and Lincoln Yards.

listings.name: 1710 N Damen Ave
listings.description: Boutique street-level retail opportunity located on one of Bucktown’s most sought-after blocks along N. Damen Avenue. The space is positioned within a dense, affluent neighborhood and benefits from consistent foot traffic driven by nearby residential density and the highly visited 606 Trail corridor. The 1,000 SF layout is well-suited for both emerging and established brands looking to maximize visibility and capture walk-in traffic in a proven retail corridor. Strong transit access, including proximity to the Damen Blue Line CTA station, further enhances accessibility for both customers and employees. Surrounded by a curated mix of national retailers and popular dining destinations, the location supports sustained consumer demand and brand exposure within one of Chicago’s most active boutique retail environments.
